summary: Plan CSA shares, seasonal supply and safer handling with practical course exercises. Explore the five-day foundation training.
lede: Local food systems and community-supported agriculture training helps coordinators plan seasonal supply and member distribution. Designed for farm coordinators, food hub staff and community food organizers, this foundation course covers supply mapping, CSA readiness, crop and share planning, basic costing, harvest handling and traceability. You practise creating practical plans and member updates that account for changing harvests and distribution needs.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who coordinate local food production, CSA membership, community distribution or the supporting services that connect them. It suits you if you need practical tools for planning seasonal supply and communicating clearly with producers and members.
prerequisites: No specialist CSA knowledge is assumed. Familiarity with your work in food production, distribution or community food activity will help you apply the exercises.
